name: Leprechaun Brotherhood
description:
Leprechaun brotherhood — a mysterious group of master-wizards who can neatly handle gold and gems better than anyone else. Their magic is known for its power and unusual abilities that they use in battles. There is a leprechaun-wizard in the brotherhood who has magical powers and can bring an army of gold golems to a battlefield to attack an opponent. There is also an alchemist-dwarf, whose knowledge of chemistry let them create potions and elixirs to boost combart abilities of the team.
See also: Paints
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on March 17, 2023.
The paint was sold in the game from the 17th to 28th of March, 2023 in the "Lucky coin" special offer during the "Gold rush" event.
